text:
Anika: scheduling this thread to synthesize recurring incident themes from the last quarter and turn them into a concrete remediation sprint. want owners + deliverables by EOD.
Tom: I reviewed 14 PMs. top recurring buckets: 1) memory pressure from large-context runs, 2) autoscaler oscillation on burst traffic, 3) config drift causing failed rollbacks, 4) percentile storage latency spikes, 5) healthcheck flappiness for sidecars.
Priya: can you drop links to the PMs you pulled? i'll map them to existing action items.
Tom: linked in tracker: INC-301, INC-322, GH-1204, GH-1187. added brief notes per-incident.
Ethan: ok i'll own memory-pressure work. plan: short-term mitigations (soft request token cap + oom-sandbox) by 4/01, long-term: perf harness + model slice tests by 5/20.
Zoe: i'll take autoscaler oscillation. hypothesis: scale-down policy too aggressive + probe latency variance. plan: reproduce in chaos staging by 3/29, config change + canary by 4/10.
Anika: assign owners in tracker and add a "sprint" column. we'll treat these as a focused 2-week sprint.
Priya: i'll own the config drift initiatives. short-term: add stricter pre-deploy validation + automatic rollback gate by 3/24. longer: audit tooling + immutable env snapshots by 5/5.
Tom: storage latency: I can help with tracing; need eng-infra to instrument SLO heatmaps. Zoe, can you coordinate with infra for staging load?
Zoe: pinged #eng-infra and put a follow-up in the tracker.
Ethan: sample log showing out-of-memory path: ```2026-03-05T14:22:11Z ERROR allocator: oom killing shard_id=8 rss=15.7G limit=14.0G trace=alloc/growth```
Priya: good to capture. add repro steps and corp-slo hits to the tracker so we can prioritize.
Anika: risk table: label items P0/P1 for the sprint. memory-pressure P0, autoscaler P1, config-drift P1, storage-latency P2, sidecar-health P2. owners confirm?
Ethan: confirm P0 for memory-pressure. will create GH issue and link to tracker (GH-1310). timeline: investigation done 4/01, PR 4/07, canary 4/12.
Zoe: confirm autoscaler P1. will add canary runbook and rollback plan. timeline looks good.
Priya: config drift P1 confirmed. I'll publish a pre-deploy validation checklist today.
Tom: storage latency telemetry ticket created (GH-1302). need infra to allocate observability runway.
OpsBot: reminder: add sprint labels and due dates in incident tracker: https://go.redwood/incident-tracker
Anika: require weekly status updates in tracker. I'll run a 15m stand at the end of week 1.
Zoe: added mitigation: temporary scale cushion during known traffic windows to reduce oscillation risk.
Ethan: note: short-term caps may increase tail latency for some customers. i'll add customer-impact notes in the tracker.
Priya: cross-team dependency: deployment of validation tooling needs CI quota bump. @Tom can you file infra request?
Tom: filed infra request: INFRA-772. ETA for quota increase 3/26.
Anika: excellent. deliverables recap: owners and dates in tracker; canary runbooks (Zoe, Ethan) by 4/05; pre-deploy checks (Priya) by 3/24; retro slide for leadership with themes + ask by 4/08.
Zoe: will draft canary runbook and include rollback checklist.
Ethan: I'll add perf harness design doc and testing plan to GH-1310.
Priya: adding a post-sprint verification item: validate incident recurrence rate drops for two consecutive weeks.
Tom: final note: avoid splitting fixes across too many PRs; prefer 1-2 cohesive changes per theme to simplify rollbacks.
Anika: thanks all. reconvene in 2 weeks for outcomes. OpsBot, snapshot tracker when sprint starts.
OpsBot: snapshot created: https://go.redwood/incident-tracker/1796031122
